description: Scrub text before it goes to a model or a log: JSON body {text, mask} (max 100,000 chars). Finds emails, phones, SSNs, cards (Luhn), IBANs, IPs, MAC addresses, API keys, JWTs, private keys, wallet addresses. mask is label, hash or star. Returns redacted text and counts. Not stored. Price $0.003 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"redacted":"Contact [EMAIL] or [PHONE]. Card [CREDIT_CARD].","mask":"label","total_found":3,"counts":{"email":1,"phone":1,"credit_card":1},"findings":[{"type":"email","start":8,"end":20,"length":12}]}
name: pii_redact
